# Stump: a broken octagonal pillar on a square base, its top jagged. Blocks the beam.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Stone --base-color 0.1569 0.1020 0.1765 --no-slot
material new Cap --base-color 0.4196 0.1373 0.2549 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Base --size 1 --location 0.000 0.000 0.080
scale 0.800 0.800 0.160
apply --scale
add mesh cylinder --name Shaft --vertices 8 --radius 0.3 --depth 1.0 --location 0 0 0.62
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z > 0.4"
randomize --amount 0.16 --seed 11
mode object
select Base Shaft
active Base
join
rename Base Stump
material assign Stone
mode edit
select face where "normal.z > 0.7"
material assign Cap
select face where "normal.z < -0.9"
delete only-faces
mode object
shade flat
export stump.glb
